fields.why: The text ranks the sex × age cells ('highest among males aged 25–44 years'), and Tables 1–2 show rates for 3+ SPD groups.

Tables 1–2 also set age-adjusted rates and % changes side by side for three race/ethnicity groups (and seven age groups); 'shown' values with no assessment across them qualify as side by side. The z/gamma tests compare 2014 vs 2015 within each level, so they make no entry (rule 6).
No test is run across SPD levels; the z-tests and gamma CI-nonoverlap compare years within each level, so the mechanical flag does not apply. The sex × age ranking and table values are side by side.

brief_issues: Whether SPD rows of an interpretive table with no text claim across them earn a side-by-side entry is not stated explicitly; 'shown or ranked' implies yes.
